user.title: Connect to The Frame
user.description: The TV must be on (Art Mode counts) and on your network.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description: The TV did not allow the connection. Make sure it is on, press Allow on the prompt, and try again. If you pressed Deny once, remove "Frame Daily Plan" under Settings > Connection > External Device Manager > Device Connection Manager > Device List on the TV.

progress.pair: Press **Allow** on the TV when it asks about "Frame Daily Plan" (you have two minutes).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach a Samsung TV at this address
error.not_a_frame: This Samsung TV has no Art Mode

show_plan.name: Show plan
show_plan.description: Render today's plan and show it in Art Mode. Remembers the current artwork and pauses the TV's slideshow.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Which Frame (optional if only one is configured).

restore_artwork.name: Restore artwork
restore_artwork.description: Bring the previous artwork and slideshow back and delete the plan image from the TV.
